summary.text: Brian Crosby is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 29B in St. Mary's County, first elected in 2018 and a member since January 9, 2019. His official page lists him as Deputy Majority Leader and a member of the Economic Matters Committee.

paragraphs.text: Crosby's official page says he was born in Clifton Heights, Pennsylvania, and lists a B.B.A. in business administration from Drexel University in 2005 and a J.D. from Western Michigan University Cooley Law School in 2008.
It lists service in the U.S. Army infantry from 2011 to 2015, including Afghanistan, and in the Maryland Army National Guard as a captain from 2016 to 2020.
It lists him as a consultant at Booz Allen Hamilton from 2016 to 2018 and as Southern Maryland representative and deputy director of the Maryland Veterans Council from 2018.
The page says he was Vice Chair of the Economic Matters Committee from 2021 to 2025 and Chair of its Public Utilities Subcommittee from 2023 to 2025.
